description: Per-screen quality gate: lint one frame → { pass, findings, counts, fixes }; a finding carries its own fix only when it differs from fixes[code]. Errors: invisible text, overflow, zero-size, collapsed auto-layout, low contrast. Warnings: misaligned rows, hand-drawn icons, placeholder avatars, raw fills/text, detached instances. Capped at 200, errors first.
name: figma_review_screen
